lines: My dear listeners, I'm happy to say that I found a really good friend, who owns a restaurant at the corner of Belkan Way.
They serve really good food, have excellent service, most of the time, and most importantly, are staffed by a kind and generous help owner, who wants what is best for the people, first and foremost.
If you have any kupars to spare, I implore you to spend them at this establishment.
